data.action: 靠在酒店窗座，一条腿沿着玻璃伸展，一手撑稳坐垫。
data.description: 成年海梦靠在酒店落地窗旁的窗座上，一条腿沿着玻璃伸展，颈间保留细项圈；窗外霓虹映进室内。
data.lighting: warm room light and glittering city view
data.promptProse: Adult Marin reclines on the hotel window seat with one leg extended along the glass, steadying herself with a palm on the cushion. City neon colors the window edge while warm room light shapes the near side of her face.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 夜景落地窗
data.animaCaption: One palm steadies her on the cushion while one leg extends along the window glass.
